meta.title: Pro Fantasy — Download the Liga MX fantasy app
meta.description: Download Pro Fantasy for free on the App Store: live draft, pools and Survivor for Liga MX with your friends. Android coming soon.

hero.subtitle: Set up your private league, draft live pick by pick and take on your friends every Liga MX matchday.

download.qrAlt: QR code to download Pro Fantasy from the App Store
download.qrHint: Scan it with your iPhone camera
download.web: No iPhone? Play on the web

items.draft: Draft live, pick by pick: your turn, the clock and the draft board in real time.
items.pitch: Your eleven, on the pitch: your lineup with points and positions.
items.standings: All of Liga MX, up to date: the table, form and your featured teams.
items.table: Climb the table and brag: your rank and your points against your league.
items.matchup: Every matchday, a duel: head to head against another team in your league.
items.leagues: All your leagues at a glance: scores, pending picks and what closes soon.
items.pools: Predict every match: exact-score pool, matchday by matchday.
items.survivor: Survivor: pick one team per matchday, no repeats, and survive.
items.results: Follow your teams: Liga MX results and fixtures.

preview.title: A live draft, in 30 seconds
preview.body: Recorded on an iPhone: your turn's clock, the wishlist and the board filling up pick by pick.
preview.videoLabel: Pro Fantasy video on an iPhone: a live draft

modes.title: Fantasy, pools and Survivor in one app

fantasy.name: Fantasy with a live draft
fantasy.body: Pick your players in turns against the clock, set your eleven and face another team in your league every matchday.

pools.name: Pools
pools.body: Predict the score of every match and earn points for the exact score, the winner or a draw.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.body: One team per matchday, no repeats. If it loses, you lose a life; the last one standing wins.

leagues.label: Leagues
leagues.value: Liga MX for free. Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A and Bundesliga with Premium.
